feature_mapping.part: MAIN VALVE, SERVICE VALVE, FARM TAP METER/REGULATOR SET -> OTHER; all other raw values retained
feature_mapping.mat: COPPER, DUCTILE IRON -> OTHER; all other raw values retained

plan.model: Unpenalized binomial GLM, categorical main effects with intercept; no interactions
plan.shared_fit_rule: No logistic hyperparameter selection for any specification. Initial fit through start-3, descriptive validation start-2:start-1, then refit all years before test start. All six specifications reported; validation and test outcomes do not select a feature set.
plan.fit_failure_rule: Retain diagnostics and missing predictions; never substitute a regularized model. No four-window comparison is reported as complete if a required fit is unavailable.
plan.tie_rule: Exact equal fitted scores; random boundary-tie expected hits, with min/max retained
plan.aggregate_AP: Equal-weight mean of within-window APs/differences; never pool scores across fitted windows

cluster_uncertainty.unit: operator, jointly across windows and all six specifications
cluster_uncertainty.draw_generator: numpy PCG64 multinomial(G, 1/G), sorted string operator IDs
cluster_uncertainty.zero_event_rule: Zero-casualty draws retain zero hits. AP and recall are undefined only when their own denominator is zero. Aggregate recall remains defined when total casualties are positive; mean-window AP requires AP in all four windows. Empty windows have undefined budget metrics.
cluster_uncertainty.scope: Fixed fitted scores; resampled windows each receive ceil(0.2*N) slots. Intervals do not include fitting, tuning, data-version or new-operator uncertainty; pointwise exploratory intervals, no multiplicity adjustment.

interpretation: Conditional predictive contribution under this one fixed additive logistic method; not causal feature importance, not a search for a winning subset, and not an untouched or prospective validation.
